hypothesis: A single storage larger than 2 GiB in the 8 GiB window is written by DMA, read entirely by a standard Torch device reduction and read back, and strided kernels whose element offsets scale past 2^31 bytes address it correctly.
competing_explanations: XRT refuses or places differently an 8 GiB BO in MBG[0:31] on this image (host memory, group map)
a platform/interconnect address-map segment narrower than the xclbin connectivity drops PC16-PC31
a high address bit is lost in RTL that the audit and RTL simulation missed (aliasing probes)
generated kernels scale int32 element offsets in 32-bit arithmetic (bigoffset/stream only)
host transfer path cost or memory for multi-GiB transfers (diagnostic, not a window limit)
expected_counter_changes: outlet read/write line deltas on all three outlets for the probe kernels
each launch issues and completes programs on all three cores (peak_active 3)
stream: outlet read lines x 64 B >= the 2.25 GiB storage for one row reduction
R_AXI_STAT error/stray bits stay clear after every case
expected_observations: bigoffset: 2.25 GiB storage: strided device read/write at byte offsets above 2^31
stream: 2.25 GiB storage: 36 x 64 MiB DMA in, device row reduction over all of it, DMA out

board.load_policy: loaded only by evidence/r41/stage2/board/launches/board_queue.sh after the Stage 1 and hbm8 queues finished and the card was idle 15 consecutive minutes (user authorization for this image only); every fpga step probes the loaded UUID, the 100 MHz clock counter and kdsstat first and refuses otherwise; the clock evidence is captured after that load

registration.order: as listed; one process per case
registration.xclbin_map: evidence/r41/stage2/board/xclbin_hbm_map.json: identical HBM topology, group connectivity and 4/8 GiB allocation to the B40 map
